integrity: All stated infinite claims have full mathematical proofs; finite brute-force checks serve only as consistency tests; no independent priority or proof audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite rook graphs K_m square K_n for integers m,n>=2; the generating functions are formal; possible undiscovered preexisting enumeration remains a bibliographic risk, notably full text of Tankus–Tarsi (2007).
title: Purity and complete forest enumeration of rectangular rook graphs
